title: Patreon memberships
one_liner: Fans pay monthly for extras: bonus posts, early videos, behind the scenes.
followers: None, but you need fans who want more from you.
pay: You set tier prices. New creators since 4 Aug 2025 pay a 10% platform fee plus processing (US card 2.9% + $0.30).
steps: Pick one extra fans already ask for.
Make one tier at a simple price.
Announce it in your next 3 videos.
catch: Most creators start with a handful of members; it grows slowly and needs regular posts.
sources: Patreon: platform fee for new creators

match.first_step: Write down one extra your fans ask for and plan 4 posts of it.
